definition: A statistical technique that transforms data into a new set of orthogonal variables (principal components) ranked by how much variance they explain.
details: PCA is a classic dimensionality-reduction method used for data visualization, noise reduction, and as a preprocessing step before other machine learning algorithms.
story: Imagine a chef tasting every ingredient before it goes into the pot, deciding what belongs and what would ruin the broth. Better ingredients make a better meal, and the same is true here. Every machine is shaped by what it was shown, so someone has to choose that material with care. It is the raw material; the model is only ever as good as what it was fed. That care with the raw material is Principal Component Analysis.
